## v0.5.19 · DSH 0.2, Desktop Memory and a Guided First Install

- **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 support.** DSH checks every `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer range before installing a plugin and at startup, and refused earlier releases on 0.2. The Starter and the Memory Spaces Source now accept `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`. (#311)
- **Manage memory in DSH Desktop.** Desktop windows (`dsh-app://app/`) now use Mnemon's local channels, so Runtime memory, Memory Spaces and the plugin settings are editable with default settings. Pages opened from another device stay read only and say why. Status also names the Mnemon CLI version on a fresh install. (#310, #311)
- **Consistent memory interactions.** One Save to memory dialog with a receipt, a turn memory bar whose items open where they live, and DSH's own inputs, selectors and modal layer. (#307)
- **A guide from an empty machine to the first memory**, for the web, the desktop app and the command line, with screenshots and recordings from real DSH 0.2. (#307, #311)

Changed packages: **dsh-mnemon 0.5.19**, **dsh-mnemon-source-runtime 0.5.11**, **dsh-mnemon-source-documents 0.5.8**, **dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces 0.5.13** and **dsh-mnemon-provider-mnemon-native 0.5.7**. The other 13 component versions remain unchanged.

### Upgrade

Supports **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2** (npm `latest`) and **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1** (npm `next`). Install `dsh-mnemon@0.5.19` through **Add plugin**, then **Enable now**, or run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.19
```

Include the version for the first 24 hours: pnpm 11 skips versions younger than a day and would install the previous release, which DSH 0.2 refuses. Update dsh-mnemon before moving a profile to DSH 0.2. Desktop users update from the app's Plugins page; no `remoteAccess` change is needed. If the host already loaded an older version, restart DSH once and reload the browser. No data migration.

### 中文说明

- **支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1。** DSH 在安装插件前和启动时检查 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer 范围，此前版本在 0.2 上会被拒绝。Starter 与记忆空间 Source 现在接受 `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`。(#311)
- **桌面版可以管理记忆。** 桌面窗口（`dsh-app://app/`）改用 Mnemon 本地通道，运行时记忆、记忆空间与插件设置以默认配置即可编辑；从其他设备打开的页面保持只读并写明原因。全新安装后状态页会写出 Mnemon CLI 版本。(#310、#311)
- **记忆交互一致。** 统一的“存入记忆”对话框与回执，回合记忆栏条目直达所在位置，使用 DSH 自己的输入框、选择器与弹窗层级。(#307)
- **从空白电脑到第一条记忆的安装指南**，覆盖网页、桌面版与命令行，配有真实 DSH 0.2 的截图与录屏。(#307、#311)

发布后 24 小时内请安装 `dsh-mnemon@0.5.19`（pnpm 11 不会选用发布不足一天的版本）。升级到 DSH 0.2 前先更新 dsh-mnemon；桌面版在应用的插件页中更新，无需修改 `remoteAccess`。已加载旧版的实例升级后重启一次 DSH 并刷新浏览器。无需迁移数据。
